scope: A Chat PostgREST request rejected with HTTP 401 renews the exact persisted session and retries once on Web and iOS, matching the existing Android transport. Concurrent login/logout cannot be overwritten and an actor change prevents replay.

validation.android: Selective gate reuse: Android sources and common runtime were unchanged; SupabaseHttpClient.executeRequest already forces refresh on 401 and retries once.
